reasoning: Parliamentary elections are scheduled for March 22, 2026 (16 days from the forecast date). Multiple polls show Janez Janša's SDS leading with ~22-23% support, ahead of PM Golob's Freedom Movement at ~18-19%. Polls indicate the right-wing coalition (SDS + allied parties) could secure ~45 seats, sufficient for a 46-seat majority in the 90-seat parliament. However, coalition-building remains uncertain: tensions exist between Janša and other right-wing parties (Logar's Democrats, Resni.ca), and Resni.ca has publicly rejected cooperation with SDS. PM Golob faces integrity violations findings from the anti-corruption agency, weakening his position. While Janša appears the frontrunner, actual government formation depends on post-election negotiations. The high number of undecided voters (19.7%) and potential for surprises add uncertainty. The deadline for PM swearing-in is December 31, 2026.
